title: The DM's screen no longer misses players' 3D dice rolls
summary: In shared campaigns, a player's roll now always reaches the Dungeon Master's 3D dice, even while the campaign is busy with other changes or the DM's device clock is off. Opening a campaign still never replays old rolls.
items: A roll made while other players or the DM were changing the campaign could be skipped on the DM's screen and the TV / player display; it is now thrown within a couple of seconds.
A DM device whose clock runs fast or slow no longer drops new rolls or replays old ones.
